title: 污泥乾燥與熱回收
summary: 本課以水分蒸發、熱回收與乾燥系統邊界為主線，從濕乾基分辨、蒸發水量、汽化潛熱、進料與產品顯熱進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops evaporation, heat recovery and dryer system boundaries through ten connected units, beginning with wet and dry bases, evaporated-water balance, latent-heat requirement, feed and product sensible heat. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 濕乾基分辨：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Wet and dry bases: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 濕乾基分辨 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Wet and dry bases and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 先固定乾固體庫存，再用進出含固率計算需移除的水。
steps.instructionEn: Fix dry-solids inventory before calculating water removal from inlet/outlet solids fractions.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.
steps.failure: 把濕基含水率直接當乾基含水比。診斷與介入：用代表性含固樣本重算乾量，避免濕重混用。
steps.failureEn: Wet-basis moisture is mistaken for dry-basis moisture ratio. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry mass from representative solids samples, without mixing wet mass.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「濕乾基分辨」的觀測點。由體積、密度與烘乾固體三個獨立量測建質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for wet and dry bases. Build mass from independent volume, density and oven-dry solids measurements. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 TS:0.04→0.05，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2000 變為 2500 kg DS/d。用「濕乾基分辨」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only TS:0.04→0.05, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2000 to 2500 kg DS/d. Explain the direction using wet and dry bases, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

steps.title: 蒸發水量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Evaporated-water balance: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 蒸發水量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Evaporated-water balance and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 乾燥主要減少水而非乾固體，產品濕重隨含固率非線性變化。
steps.instructionEn: Drying primarily removes water, not dry solids; wet mass changes nonlinearly with solids fraction.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：乾固體=1000 kg；進料 TS=0.25；產品 TS=0.90。模型 Mevap=MDS(1/TSin-1/TSout)，代入得到 2888.8889 kg water。適用邊界：假定乾固體無損失；揮發有機物與粉塵另列。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Dry solids=1000 kg; feed TS=0.25; product TS=0.90. Model Mevap=MDS(1/TSin-1/TSout) gives 2888.8889 kg water. Applicability: Assumes conserved dry solids; volatile organics and dust require separate terms.
steps.failure: 未列粉塵與揮發損失就宣稱固體全守恆。診斷與介入：先由乾固體收支確認需去除水量，再比較熱負荷。
steps.failureEn: Ignoring dust/volatile losses overstates exact solids conservation. Diagnostic response: Confirm water removal through the dry-solids balance before comparing heat demand.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「蒸發水量」的觀測點。由進料、產品及冷凝水重量重建水分收支。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for evaporated-water balance. Rebuild the water balance from feed, product and condensate masses. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 蒸發水量

Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
